Fixed: End navigation closes the driving screen before releasing browser services, so a map, speech or screen-awake cleanup error cannot leave guidance stuck open.
Ending guidance cancels pending rerouting and ignores late location or route callbacks.
Arrival invalidates queued GPS callbacks so finished guidance is not restarted by an old location update.

title: Find typed places and choose locations on the map

Improved: Find my route now resolves typed starting points and destinations instead of requiring a suggestion to be selected first.
Matching places show fuller address details, with a confirmation list when several locations match.
Search distinguishes no matches from service failures and ignores outdated responses after edits.
Added: Choose a starting point or destination by tapping the map or dragging a pin, then confirm the location.

notes: Place coverage still depends on the search data. Map pins may route to a nearby accessible road; check the entrance before starting.

Improved: Map credits collapse to a small information control when the driving map loads or the phone rotates.
The credit control sits away from the speed and navigation buttons, with provider links still available on tap.

title: Clear speed display and navigation controls

Fixed: Speed and recenter controls now share one layout, preventing them from overlapping.
Control spacing follows the actual height of the ETA panel, including wrapped text and phone safe areas.
Improved: The speed readout appears first in the control stack. A compact grid keeps controls accessible in short landscape views.

title: Live route planning with reported closures

Improved: TomTom now chooses the road path using current traffic and reported closures, rather than only estimating the arrival time on an OSRM route.
Off-route automatic replanning also uses live routing and matching turn instructions.
Route labels show the provider and when closures were checked at planning time.
Added: Explicit basic-routing fallback when the live service is unavailable, labelled road closures NOT checked.

notes: Coverage depends on the provider. Newly blocked or unreported roads may be missing. Closures are checked when planning or replanning; this release does not add continuous closure monitoring or a manual road-block avoidance button.
A route rejected by live routing is not silently replaced with a basic route. API keys remain server-side.

title: Anonymous visitor statistics

Added: A public Lapan in numbers page showing map-page visits, estimated active tabs, recent daily counts, and broad device/browser totals.
A browser-local tracking opt-out and support for Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control.

notes: Counts start with this release and are approximate page visits, not unique people. No names, IP addresses, GPS coordinates, destinations or routes are stored by the visitor counter.

title: Road numbers and exit signs in directions

Improved: Turn instructions include road references, signed exit numbers and signposted destinations when supplied by the routing data.
The same information appears in navigation, the directions list and spoken guidance.
Clearer instructions for motorway exits, entry ramps and forks; roundabout exit counts remain separate from signed highway exit numbers.

notes: Coverage depends on the routing map. Missing exit references are not guessed; an example exit number is not treated as verified road data.

title: Add Lapan to your Home Screen

Added: An English illustrated guide for adding Lapan to an iPhone or Android Home Screen.
iPhone Safari steps, Android Chrome install instructions, and a Create shortcut fallback.
Branded Home Screen icons and a web app manifest for supported browsers.

notes: A shortcut may open in the browser. Internet access is still required for navigation services; there is no offline map download.

title: Voice guidance your way

Added: Voice & sound settings with Normal, Less chatty, Alerts only and Off modes.
Open settings before a trip or from the speaker button during navigation.
Voice mode and navigator voice are saved only in your own browser and restored on your next visit.
Improved: Less chatty skips distant turn reminders and speaks within 200 metres. Alerts only announces route updates and arrival.
Manual repeat remains available in enabled modes; Off cancels automatic speech.

notes: Alerts only does not provide live road-hazard alerts. Device voice availability varies, and browser storage must be available to remember preferences.

Improved: Larger, high-contrast ETA and remaining journey time during navigation.
Arrival estimates on route cards are easier to read.
Navigation actions sit below the journey information on a compact card so they do not squeeze the ETA.
The main app, changelog and browser tab use the same green Lapan icon with its white infinity symbol.
Shared vector artwork keeps the logo consistent across fonts, devices and screen sizes.

title: A separate toll calculator

Improved: Moved the PLUS toll calculator out of route planning into its own Toll calculator option.
Choose entry and exit plazas without planning a route. Fare estimates are independent of navigation and do not change your journey.
Removed toll estimates and automatic plaza suggestions from route cards and route selection.

notes: PLUS fares cover the chosen plazas for a Class 1 car. Other highways are not included; optional manual costs remain in the calculator.

title: A public home for release notes

Added: A mobile-friendly changelog with version numbers, release dates and links to the public GitHub history.
Open What’s new from the app header, version badge or About & privacy.
Improved: Every new release now requires a changelog entry alongside its version update.

notes: Release notes describe user-facing changes. They do not publish private configuration or credentials.

title: Traffic-aware arrival estimates

Added: TomTom traffic-aware ETA for the selected route, including arrival time and remaining journey duration.
Route matching checks help keep traffic estimates aligned with the road route shown on the map.
Improved: Traffic is reassessed at most once every two minutes during navigation.
The selected route card updates its duration and arrival estimate when traffic data is available.
Clear labels distinguish TomTom traffic from the baseline road estimate.

notes: If traffic data is unavailable, a provider limit is reached or the route cannot be matched, Lapan uses the road estimate.
This release adds traffic-aware ETA; coloured live-congestion map overlays are not enabled.

Improved: One application version is used across the header and About & privacy.
New releases increment the patch version. Rebuilds and deployment retries keep the same release number.

title: Clearer guidance, voice recovery and map details

Added: Mapped traffic-light locations in 2D and 3D views, with a toggle under Map details.
Arrival clock time, remaining minutes and distance that update with GPS progress.
A repeat-instruction button and reminders as you approach a turn.
A visible application version.
Fixed: Voice announcements can finish before the next one starts; interrupted or stalled speech gets a bounded retry.
Unmuting voice guidance triggers a fresh instruction.
Improved: Screen-awake starts automatically during navigation and attempts recovery after interruptions, with a compatibility fallback and visible status.

notes: Traffic-light icons indicate mapped locations only, not live red/green signal status. Coverage may be incomplete.
Screen-awake and voice behaviour depend on browser and phone support. In this release, arrival estimates did not yet use live traffic.
These updates were published under version 1.0.8 before per-release numbering was introduced.

title: Early public development

Added: Public source code, tests and a deployment guide on GitHub.
A compact Quick stops picker for nearby petrol stations, R&R stops and shopping centres.
Recent locations saved in the browser, device voice selection and PLUS Class 1 toll-fare lookup.
Improved: Heading-following 2D navigation, a tilted 3D map, smooth vehicle movement and compact driving controls.
Automatic rerouting keeps GPS active and retries when the routing connection fails.
Toll-plaza choices and secondary options stay collapsed until opened.

notes: This section groups the early public commits; it does not assign version numbers retroactively.
Nearby-stop distances are straight-line distances. Check road access and highway direction. PLUS fares do not include every highway operator.
